source: USGS SIM 3464 (Sun & Stack 2020), 1:75,000, USGS-NASA Planetary Geologic Mapping Program
offsetNote: Drawn on a semi-controlled CTX mosaic: offsets of ~100-200 m.

units.name: Jezero fan 1 (lower delta)
units.notes: Layered river sediment laid down where a river met the old lake. A top place to look for signs of past life.
units.age: Noachian to Hesperian (about 3.9–3.0 billion years old)

units.name: Jezero fan 2 (main delta)
units.notes: The delta: river sediment with clays and carbonates. Perseverance explored and sampled its front.
units.age: Noachian to Hesperian (about 3.9–3.0 billion years old)

units.name: Jezero floor
units.notes: Crater floor. Perseverance found it is volcanic (igneous) rock, the Máaz and Séítah formations.

units.name: Lower etched unit
units.notes: Olivine-rich rock low in the crater, possibly changed by the ancient lake water.

units.name: Upper etched unit
units.notes: Olivine-rich rock found across the region. Wind-carved ridges (yardangs) in places.

units.name: Nili Planum 1
units.notes: Oldest rock here, the ground the Jezero impact hit. Holds megabreccia: shattered blocks 10–100 m across.

units.name: Nili Planum 2
units.notes: Flat-topped cap rock with lobed edges that sheds boulders. Watch your footing near its edges.

units.name: Nili Planum fan
units.notes: River deposits inside Neretva Vallis, the channel that fed the lake.

units.name: Rugged bright unit
units.notes: Light-toned rugged mounds sitting on the etched unit. Rough going.

units.name: Smooth unit
units.notes: Smooth dark cover thick enough to hide the rock beneath. Easy walking, little bedrock to sample.
units.age: Age set by the crater that formed it

units.name: Windblown sand (eolian bedforms)
units.notes: Sand ripples and dunes. Soft sand can trap wheels (it stranded the Spirit rover) and tires walkers. Cross with care, avoid by rover.

units.name: Crater rim
units.notes: Raised rim rock of Jezero and smaller craters, with megabreccia blocks. Often steep.
units.age: Age set by the crater that formed it

units.name: Crater ejecta
units.notes: Rock thrown out by impacts. Expect scattered boulders.
units.age: Age set by the crater that formed it

units.name: Crater interior
units.notes: Bedrock in the middle of a crater.
units.age: Age set by the crater that formed it
